subject: Recap & Next Steps: monthly token bands + procurement thresholds
procurement_thresholds: Procurement says: PO required for >$25k/yr; legal review for >$50k/yr; finance prefers annual commit for discounts.
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Wells <sam.wells@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Recap & Next Steps: monthly token bands + procurement thresholds

Sam — thanks for the time today. Quick written recap so we have explicit next steps and the numbers you called out on the call.

Key points I captured:
- Expected monthly token volume (production): 150M — 250M tokens/month (peak season could hit ~300M).
- Target unit economics: target ~$12 per 1M tokens (customer stated target when we discussed value vs. cost).
- Preferred billing cadence: monthly, but team is open to annual commit for a discount.
- Procurement thresholds (as you mentioned): internal PO path for purchases above the $25k/year mark; anything >$50k/year will loop in legal for contract terms.

Proposed next steps:
1) I attached a tiered pricing sheet (redwood-pricing-tiered.xlsx) with a baseline and commitment discount band — please review against your target $/1M figure.
2) If numbers look reasonable, can we schedule a 30-minute follow-up with your procurement lead next week to confirm PO process and timing? Proposed slots: Tue/Wed morning (your time).
3) I'll prepare a 90-day POC proposal with a capped spend option so procurement can see a low-risk path to evaluate latency and unit economics.

Quick ask for you: can you confirm the monthly token band (low/high) we should model for SOW/PO? I used 150M / 250M as a working assumption. Also confirm the internal procurement contact and whether the PO threshold you referenced is $25k/year.

Attachment: redwood-pricing-tiered.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3 sheets)

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

From: Sam Wells <sam.wells@acmehealth.com>

Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 16:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap & Next Steps: monthly token bands + procurement thresholds

Thanks for the recap, Sergio — that matches what we discussed. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Monthly band for planning: 120M (conservative) — 300M (high). For the commercial decision we should plan around the mid: 180M — 220M.
- Target unit economics: the org is aiming for ~$10–$15 per 1M tokens; $12 is a good midpoint to model with.
- Procurement: correct — PO required for any annual commitment > $25k. For pilot/POC spend under that threshold we can process via a standard requisition without a long procurement timeline.

Procurement lead: Claire Donnelly (cc'd procurement@acmehealth.com) — Claire will set expectations for contracting & invoice terms.

Next step: Claire, can we schedule a quick sync this week to run through the PO process and expected turnaround? Sergio: if you can send the 90-day POC outline and an estimated monthly invoice we can get an internal sense-check before the procurement meeting.

Looping you both in — Sam confirmed the 120M–300M band and procurement thresholds; procurement lead is Claire (procurement@acmehealth.com).

Action items for us:
- Monica: can you draft the 90-day POC with a cap and the monthly estimated invoice using $12/1M tokens and the following modeled bands: low 120M, mid 200M, high 300M? Put the three-line pricing table at the top so procurement can see the math at a glance.
- Neha: please prepare a short note on data handling and SOC 2 evidence that we can attach to the SOW (Acme will likely ask for that in procurement).
- I'll coordinate availability with Claire for a 30-minute procurement sync — target Wed/Thu morning next week.

I'll attach the draft POC and send once Monica builds the numbers.

Sergio
